children: said on Tuesday it was on track to meet its earnings target for this year after adjusted profit fell 5.4% in the first nine months.
Excluding one-offs, such as sales of assets, profit for the January-September period was €195.8 million ($219.84 million), down from €206.9 million a year earlier as regulated revenue declined.
Reported net profit fell to €204.1 million compared with €262.8 million in the same period last year.
